news.title: CoreWeave shares tumble as bond yields near 15% on concern about AI borrowing binge
news.description: Shares of CoreWeave sank 15%, while yields in its bonds blew out further.

news.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
news.description: U.S. inflation has stayed elevated for years, raising concern at the Federal Reserve that consumers may come to expect stubbornly high prices.

news.title: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks
news.description: Iran has escalated its strikes on commercial ships transiting Hormuz in recent weeks, as it tries to choke off a rebound in crude oil exports.
